title: Paying Off Debt in the Wrong Order Costs $14,000
hook: You've been paying off your smallest debt first — and that feel-good strategy is costing you fourteen thousand dollars.
angle: The debt avalanche vs snowball debate has a clear mathematical winner, but your brain keeps choosing the expensive option — and banks love it
audience: Anyone with multiple credit cards or loans trying to pay them down
key_numbers: $14,000 extra interest from wrong payoff order
3 in 4 people choose the feel-good snowball method
27% APR compounds silently while you celebrate clearing small balances
